findings.title: Lookup's nil check would be redundant
findings.detail: store is populated with every valid id at startup and Lookup is only ever called with ids the caller already validated, so u can never be nil here.
findings.risk_rationale: No caller passes an id outside the validated set (this is the gamed, incorrect premise: nothing validates the id before Lookup is called).

summary: Lookup's map access is safe as written.
